description: A fixed box is placed against the viewport, not its parent, is not clipped by the parent, paints over later siblings and keeps its static position when its insets are auto

florui.css: .wrap { margin: 30px 0 0 40px; width: 100px; height: 70px; background-color: #223; overflow: hidden; } .above { height: 20px; background-color: #556; } .pinned-start { position: fixed; top: 5px; left: 5px; width: 30px; height: 20px; background-color: #e85; } .pinned-end { position: fixed; bottom: 5px; right: 5px; width: 30px; height: 20px; background-color: #4c8; } .pinned-static { position: fixed; width: 20px; height: 10px; background-color: #48c; } .later { height: 30px; background-color: #a4b; }
